City Council Meeting
TORRANCE CITY COUNCIL AGENDA
MARCH 18, 2025
REGULAR MEETING
5:00 P.M. - CLOSED SESSION
6:30 P.M. - REGULAR BUSINESS BEGINS
in council chamber AT 3031 Torrance Bl.
1.
CALL TO ORDER/ROLL CALL
2.
FLAG SALUTE/NON-SECTARIAN INVOCATION
Flag Salute - Councilmember Kalani
Invocation - Councilmember Lewis
3.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS #1 (Limited up to a 15-minute period) This portion of the meeting is reserved for comment on items under the Consent Calendar or items that are not on the agenda. Under the Ralph M. Brown Act, City Council cannot act on items raised during public comment but may respond briefly to statements made or questions posed; request clarification; or refer the item to staff. Speakers are limited to no more than 1 minute. If presenting handout material to Council, please provide 11 copies to the City Clerk before speaking.
